build_custom_foldable_tree_node: build a custom foldable tree node with collapsible label and indented children for treescope rendering
replace_with_canonical_aliases: replace object repr with canonical alias path like jax.vmap instead of memory address in treescope output
lookup_alias_in_canonical_aliases: lookup canonical alias for a well-known object using module and qualname attributes in treescope
summarize_long_qualified_names: summarize long qualified names by splitting prefix and suffix when exceeding threshold in treescope rendering
render_with_qualified_type_name_style: render object names with qualified type name styling and comment color when expanded in treescope
